headline: Anyone else get frustrated by journalists and some of the reporting of the City Charges
body: Saw a tweet from Henry Winter today. He has long been a personal favourite of mine but some of his comments actually annoyed me. He was talking about merescas performance in the press conference today. I get that it was probably commenting more on him as a human in a difficult situation but it almost felt like praise. It just made me think that we probably shouldn’t be praising city for anything around this whole situation. They have been found guilty. The whole world knew about what city were up to and find it impossible to think the manager in all his previous time and current time would have no clue of what’s going on. He has taken the money and shouldn’t be applauded for being a puppet and lying through his teeth about the innocence. Winter also touched upon the questions slowly down around this subject. That pissed me off. Surely winter and his fellow journalists have a responsibility to keep pushing this? They have tainted years and years of premier league football. I just think it’s strange that so often some of the big journalists don’t really push tough subjects. There was that legend who asked pep about two contracts after the cup final and this allegedly split the room as some felt it wasn’t the time to ask this. Are there some journalists who just like the cushy easy questions as it keeps their access.   submitted by   /u/Venkman723 [link]   [comments]
